name: create-hobby
description: Create a new hobby with the specified name and optional description. The name is required and must be between 1-255 characters. The description is optional and can be up to 1000 characters. Returns the newly created hobby with server-generated ID and timestamps. Requires authentication with a valid JWT token.

name.description: Hobby name (required, 1-255 characters, must be unique)

description.description: Description of the hobby (optional, max 1000 characters)

text.description: JSON string containing success status and created hobby data with ID and timestamps
